results.title: New Indian envoy calls on Nepal’s foreign minister
results.content: Ambassador Sudhakar Dalela meets Shisir Khanal at Singha Durbar and discusses the longstanding ties between the two countries.

results.title: Nepal’s ambassadors to India, China and Israel take oath
results.content: The three were among ten ambassadorial nominees approved by the Parliamentary Hearing Committee after the Cabinet recommended 13 appointments in September.

results.title: Night travel restricted on Hetauda-Kathmandu road via Bhimphedi
results.content: The move follows a fatal crash that killed 14 people last week, with authorities citing the narrow, winding and poorly lit road as a major accident risk.

results.title: Six wild elephants die in two months, raising conservation concerns
results.content: From Chitwan to eastern Nepal, a series of elephant deaths has alarmed conservationists, who warn that shrinking habitats, human activities and unsafe migration routes could threaten the country’s wild elephant population.

results.title: Chhath concludes with offerings to rising sun
results.content: Devotees gather on the banks of the Bagmati river in Thapathali, Kathmandu, to perform the final rituals of the four-day festival and pray for their families’ well-being.

results.title: Qatar’s economic slump puts Nepali workers’ jobs at risk
results.content: New labour approvals for Qatar have fallen by 35 percent since the war began, while rising complaints of layoffs and delayed wages point to growing pressure on Nepali workers already employed there.

results.title: Nepal’s stolen Uma-Maheshvara statues belong back in their shrines
results.content: Returning stolen statues to the country is only the first step. They should be in the shrines where generations worshipped them.

results.title: Things to do in Kathmandu Valley this week
results.content: From creative workshops and writing circles to European cinema and cricket, Kathmandu Valley has plenty to offer this week.

results.title: Nepal, India to launch Ayodhya-Janakpur train service during PM Shah’s visit
results.content: The weekly service will initially run on an Indian train. Kathmandu is also preparing to seek New Delhi’s grant assistance to electrify the 28-kilometre stretch of railway in Nepal.

results.title: Why did Nepal’s mountain agenda stall at COP31? A delegation insider explains
results.content: Environment Minister’s adviser says the real contest at COP31 is now over the wording of the cover decision.

results.title: Kathmandu to face Chitwan in NPL Eliminator after loss to Pokhara
results.content: Kathmandu finish third with a 55-run defeat, while Kushal Bhurtel misses a century by one run as Pokhara post a record 224.

results.title: Nepal sets up accreditation centre to ease testing and certification
results.content: The agency aims to reduce testing costs, strengthen quality assurance and help Nepali products gain international recognition, but exporters say it could take up to three years to secure global accreditation.

results.title: Bhurtel falls one run short as Pokhara post record NPL total
results.content: Kushal Bhurtel hits 99 off 51 balls as Pokhara Avengers pile up 224 for three against Kathmandu Gorkhas, the highest total in the competition’s history.

results.title: Changing farming practices threaten food and habitats of migratory birds
results.content: The expansion of winter crops, shrinking wetlands, and rising use of pesticide are putting the survival of thousands of birds arriving in Nepal from Tibet, Mongolia, and Siberia at risk.

results.title: Bhattarai urges Prime Minister Shah to put five issues on agenda for India visit
results.content: In an interview with Kantipur, the former prime minister says Nepal should press India on the border dispute, trade deficit, air routes and hydropower, while seeking trilateral cooperation on the Himalayan climate crisis.

results.title: India’s Nitin Gadkari to attend Nepal Infrastructure Summit as keynote speaker
results.content: The December 9–10 summit will bring together policymakers, investors and development partners to discuss infrastructure financing, regional connectivity and climate-resilient projects.
